description.text: Chinese culture and more. The subjects are taught in Chinese or English. Students will have the opportunity to visit companies, villages, residential places, scenic sports and historical sites during the period of study. Students will be divided into different groups according to their Chinese ability. In addition to their study, visiting tours and other activities are also available during their stay at Nankai. Note: Due to each group have different schedule, courses and travel destinations, the total expense at Nankai can be different from the following standards: ►Registration fee: RMB 400 per student ►Tuition: RMB 850 per week ►Accommodation: RMB 65 per day (double room) The cost of travel varies based on different destination, transportation, food, accommodations, group size and schedule.

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Economics Training Course at Nankai University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 118 USD/per week ￥ 850 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizen Be in good health, Aged between 18 and 60 years old High school graduate Hold a valid foreign passport. (If you are currently in China, you need to hold a valid Chinese visa as well.)
